description: FREE, no key or payment. Live UMA settlement risk for one Polymarket market, read from UMA's Optimistic Oracle and Polymarket's UMA CTF adapter on Polygon: uma_state, current proposal and challenge window, every dispute, whether it went to a UMA vote, bulletin-board updates, on-chain resolution, risk_level (ok|watch|caution|resolved) with a one-line recommendation, plus the segment_dispute_rate statistic and a settlement_estimate_available flag. The settlement_estimate itself is NOT in this free record: it is sold by predge_settlement_estimate (GET /v1/settlement-risk/:market/estimate, ~$0.02). The record is ed25519-signed (predge-attest-v1); this tool re-checks the signature, content hash and signer key and returns the result under `verification`. A dispute blocks a proposal; it does not by itself change the outcome. 404 unknown_market and 422 unsupported_* are NOT 'no risk' answers. Rate limit 60/min per IP. Param: market (condition id 0x+64 hex, numeric market id, or slug).
name: predge_settlement_risk
title: Settlement risk — signed live UMA dispute status (free)
